scope: Communications outbox administration and provider-ambiguity reconciliation

resolvedFindings.finding: No authorized administrative path existed to inspect or reconcile fail-closed provider-unknown outbox items
resolvedFindings.resolution: Added company/use-case-scoped GET and POST endpoints with module-specific view/manage authority checked before outbox access

resolvedFindings.finding: Provider ambiguity could not be safely resolved without direct database manipulation
resolvedFindings.resolution: Added explicit provider_accepted and provider_not_sent transitions; neither invokes provider delivery, and provider references are validated and deduplicated

resolvedFindings.finding: Administrative retries or cancellation could bypass ambiguity and lifecycle guards
resolvedFindings.resolution: Retry and cancel remain unavailable for provider_unknown items and use guarded status, attempt and expiry predicates

resolvedFindings.finding: Administrative projections could expose recipient, content or provider metadata or grow without bound
resolvedFindings.resolution: Projection excludes employee, contact, body, draft/template and provider identifiers; errors are categorized and results are capped at 100

resolvedFindings.finding: Reconciliation writes lacked atomic audit evidence
resolvedFindings.resolution: Each action creates canonical audit evidence and applies the state transition in one D1 batch with a matching audit guard

remainingLimitations: Authenticated V45 rendered acceptance is unavailable because no non-production preview URL exists
Local D1 replay remains blocked by the recorded migration-start hang
Live provider activation and production actions remain gated
